categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Bide Pharmatech Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of drug molecular building blocks and scientific reagents, serving the early stages of new drug development. The company provides a comprehensive product library with nearly 130,000 in-stock molecular building blocks and reagents, supporting drug target discovery, lead compound synthesis and optimization, and candidate drug development. It also offers customized synthesis services and operates through direct sales and distribution channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and design technologies for drug molecular building blocks, including custom synthesis, molecular structure confirmation, purity testing, and purification. It has developed multiple technical platforms such as catalyst screening, continuous flow and photochemical catalysis, fixed-bed catalytic hydrogenation, and decarboxylative cyclopropylation. Quality control is rigorous, with high-precision analytical equipment ensuring product consistency and purity. The company also integrates intelligent warehousing and supply chain management to enhance operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include innovative pharmaceutical companies, research institutes, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) both domestically and internationally. Notable clients are multinational pharmaceutical corporations like Roche, Merck KGaA, Pfizer, Abbvie, and Gilead, as well as leading Chinese pharmaceutical firms such as Hengrui Medicine and BeiGene. The company also serves academic institutions and global CROs like WuXi AppTec and Syngene. The products support new drug research and development globally, especially in major pharmaceutical R&D hubs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant international presence through subsidiaries and regional centers in the United States, Germany, India, and Hong Kong. It has established global logistics and distribution centers to support rapid delivery and localized services in key pharmaceutical innovation regions worldwide. Overseas revenue accounts for a substantial portion of total income, reflecting its global market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Bide Pharmatech operates primarily upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the development and supply of drug molecular building blocks and scientific reagents essential for early-stage drug discovery and development. It provides foundational chemical components and custom synthesis services that feed into downstream pharmaceutical R&D and manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes expanding its product variety and enhancing product quality to meet diverse and evolving customer needs. It invests heavily in R&D to develop novel molecular building blocks, improve synthesis methods, and explore applications in emerging fields such as new energy, materials, environmental protection, and medical aesthetics. Strategic initiatives include digital transformation, intelligent warehousing, global logistics optimization, and establishing overseas R&D centers to maintain technological leadership and accelerate innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and distribution of drug molecular building blocks and scientific reagents. The company also earns income from customized synthesis services tailored to client-specific requirements. Sales channels include online platforms, direct customer engagement, and participation in industry exhibitions and academic conferences. The revenue mix includes domestic and international sales, with a growing contribution from overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier of drug molecular building blocks and scientific reagents, recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise. It competes with global industry leaders such as Sigma-Aldrich, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Enamine, and Combi-Blocks. Shanghai Bide Pharmatech differentiates itself through a broad and deep product portfolio, rapid response capabilities, and expanding global footprint, positioning it as a strong challenger in both domestic and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.1 billion, representing a 0.93% year-over-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 117 million, a 7.17% increase. Total assets stood at RMB 2.42 billion with a slight growth of 0.12%. The company maintains a healthy asset-liability ratio of 16.17%. R&D investment accounted for 5.36% of revenue, reflecting sustained commitment to innovation. The company has demonstrated steady growth and profitability with improving cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Bide Pharmatech emphasizes its extensive and diverse product library, offering nearly one million structurally novel and functionally diverse drug molecular building blocks, with about 130,000 in stock for immediate supply. Its core value lies in providing high-quality, high-purity products with rapid delivery and customized synthesis capabilities, enabling clients to accelerate drug discovery and reduce development risks. The company’s global presence and intelligent supply chain further enhance its ability to meet complex and localized customer demands, positioning it as a trusted partner in new drug R&D.
